name: manual_538dbf
claim: When a reviewed patch is guarded by byte equality, generate it with full blob IDs so Git core.abbrev cannot turn identical overlay content into false unreviewed drift.

decisions.notes: A live fresh checkout serialized the same five overlay paths with a different blob-ID width than another checkout. --full-index made the candidate portable and two consecutive upgrades succeeded.

rationale: A live fresh checkout serialized the same five overlay paths with a different blob-ID width than another checkout. --full-index made the candidate portable and two consecutive upgrades succeeded.
